name: Saucy Beans on Toast
summary: Homemade tomato beans piled on buttered toast. A whole meal from two cans and a loaf.

ingredients.name: white kidney or navy beans, drained and rinsed

instructions: Heat the oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook 4–5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the tomato paste, brown sugar, and smoked paprika. Cook 1 minute.
Add the beans and 200 mL water. Stir to coat.
Simmer uncovered 10–12 minutes, stirring now and then, until the sauce is thick and clings to the beans. Mash a few beans against the side of the pan to thicken it further.
Toast the bread and butter it. Pile the beans on top and serve.

substitutions.costNote: GF bread runs about $5–6/loaf and adds roughly $3 to the dish

glutenFree.notes: The beans and sauce are naturally gluten-free. Only the toast needs swapping. Check your tomato paste and smoked paprika labels if you are highly sensitive.

budgetNotes: This is a from-scratch take on canned baked beans for about the same money and less sugar.
Any white bean works — navy, white kidney, or cannellini. A can of chickpeas works too.
A handful of grated cheese on top turns this into a heartier dinner.
Double the beans and keep them in the fridge. They reheat in two minutes for breakfast or lunch.

pricingMetadata.notes: Prices verified August 2026. White kidney beans $1.50/540mL can. Tomato paste ~$1.00/156mL can. Onion $1.07 each (priced as full onion per whole-item rule — recipe uses 0.5). Bread $2.48/loaf. Butter $1.36/100g. Oil $0.42/100mL.
